how_to_pick: Compute the memory budget (see SKILL.md), then take the FIRST tier whose min_budget_gb <= budget. min_budget_gb is the model PLUS its context, not the download size. CPU-only machines use cpu_only instead.

tiers.good_for: Biggest local model here: long context, harder reasoning
Strong all-rounder for agents and coding
Best local coding and agent work
Chat, automations, and Claude Code on small tasks

cpu_only.good_for: Short tasks; expect a few words per second

measured.note: Does not fit at 64k on a 32 GB Mac
Claude Code's ~27k-token first prompt read at ~50 tokens/s; later turns ~14 s thanks to caching

notes: Qwen 3.5-3.8 need little extra memory for context (64k added ~2-3 GB to the 9B); models with full attention, like Devstral Small 2 (64k added ~10 GB), need much more. On Apple Silicon, Ollama runs supported Qwen and Gemma models on MLX, which was ~2.6x faster here. Claude Code and other agents need 64k+ context, so only agent_ready models are offered for that.
